summary: The Underfoot Throne is the divine seat of Brell Serilis, where the subterranean god oversees the foundations of all worlds. Stone, crystal, and magma converge into pure divine authority.
history: The Throne was shaped from the first stone Brell ever touched.
Crystal roots and magma flows converge here in perfect divine harmony.
Stone guardians were forged to protect the sanctum.
Mortals reached the Throne only during the Age of Turmoil.
